page_title: AUX 1-0 LOR | Auxerre v Lorient 17/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' That's it for today, Abdelatif Kherradji has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+9' Lorient take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

90+9' Laurent Abergel (Lorient) wastes a great opportunity! He manages to control a rebound and slams it towards the bottom left corner from middle distance. Donovan Leon changes the trajectory of the shot with a fabulous last second save, punching it onto the post and away.
90+2' Fredrik Oppegard (Auxerre) violates the laws of the game and is shown a yellow card by the referee, but it could have been a straight red as well.
90' 8 additional min. will be played.
90' Christophe Pelissier prepares a substitution. Gideon Mensah is replaced by Fredrik Oppegard (Auxerre).
89' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Lorient for a penalty. Play continues.
89' The referee signals a substitution. Theo Bair (Auxerre) is brought on as a substitute for Lassine Sinayoko.
88' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Elisha Owusu (Auxerre) was quite harsh and Abdelatif Kherradji didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
87' The Lorient players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
82' Christophe Pelissier has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Lasso Coulibaly (Auxerre) replacing Josue Casimir.
82' Substitution. Rudy Matondo (Auxerre) in, Ibrahim Osman out.
82' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Lorient comes to nothing.

81' A decent save by Donovan Leon. Sambou Soumano (Lorient) finds some space near the penalty spot to meet a cross and head it down to the middle of the goal, but the effort is saved by the goalkeeper. Lorient have been awarded a corner kick.
79' Darlin Yongwa (Lorient) is penalised for a foul. Abdelatif Kherradji had a clear view and blows his whistle.
76' Josue Casimir (Auxerre) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
75' We are about to witness a subsitution. Darlin Yongwa (Lorient) for Arsene Kouassi.
73' Aiyegun Tosin (Lorient) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
70' Josue Casimir (Auxerre) misses the penalty as he smashes the ball against the crossbar!
69' Josue Casimir (Auxerre) is going to take the penalty!
69' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Auxerre!

68' Play continues despite the shouts by some Auxerre players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Abdelatif Kherradji interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
68' Surely that's handball by one of the Lorient players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
66' There's an opportunity for Josue Casimir (Auxerre) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
66' The substitution is prepared. Panos Katseris (Lorient) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Joel Mvuka Mugisha.
65' Olivier Pantaloni has decided to substitute Pablo Pagis and he is replaced by Dermane Karim (Lorient).
65' It will be a substitution. Sambou Soumano (Lorient) is ready to enter the pitch as Mohamed Bamba walks off.
64' Josue Casimir (Auxerre) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety. Auxerre will take a corner kick.
61' Abdelatif Kherradji shows a yellow card to Marvin Senaya (Auxerre) for his blatant foul.
56' Josue Casimir (Auxerre) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
56' Auxerre failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

56' Bingourou Kamara makes a brilliant save! Josue Casimir (Auxerre) easily weaves through the defence and fires the ball from mid-range. His effort goes towards the bottom left corner but is saved by the keeper! The ball is out of play. Auxerre will have a chance to score from a corner.

53' 1 - 0 Goal! Great link up play between Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) and Ibrahim Osman gives the former a clear sight of goal on the edge of the box. He doesn't disappoint and beats the keeper in the top right corner. 1:0.
52' Mohamed Bamba (Lorient) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
51' Looks like Mohamed Bamba (Lorient) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
50' Abdelatif Kherradji interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Pablo Pagis (Lorient).
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+5' The end of the first half.
45+4' Elisha Owusu (Auxerre) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
45+3' Abdelatif Kherradji blows the whistle, Laurent Abergel (Lorient) is penalised for a foul. Auxerre earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
45+1' Josue Casimir (Auxerre) produces a poor cross from the free kick which is easily turned away.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Igor Silva (Lorient) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Abdelatif Kherradji had an easy-decision to make.
44' Goal! No, wait. It's disallowed for a foul by Aiyegun Tosin (Lorient).
40' Abdelatif Kherradji blows his whistle and it's Marvin Senaya (Auxerre) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
39' Aiyegun Tosin (Lorient) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity!
34' Lorient are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
30' Abdelatif Kherradji blows his whistle for a foul after Gabriel Osho (Auxerre) hacks down one of his opponents.
25' The ref blows his whistle and we are going to have a so-called cooling break due to the high temperature.
25' Brilliant play from Aiyegun Tosin (Lorient) to get past Donovan Leon in goal, but he fails to find the net from an acute angle.
22' Aiyegun Tosin (Lorient) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
19' Pablo Pagis (Lorient) has tested the patience of referee Abdelatif Kherradji and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
17' Kevin Danois (Auxerre) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
14' Marvin Senaya (Auxerre) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Bingourou Kamara, who smothers the ball.
10' Poor challenge! Joel Mvuka Mugisha (Lorient) is penalised for tripping and Abdelatif Kherradji blows his whistle.
5' Pablo Pagis (Lorient) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
4' Marvin Senaya (Auxerre) wastes an opportunity to score with a header from inside the 18-yard box. His effort floats over the bar by a whisker!
3' Josue Casimir (Auxerre) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
3' Igor Silva (Lorient) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Auxerre.
1' The first half has just begun.
Lorient will kick the game off.
Today's referee will be Abdelatif Kherradji.
